family.rule: separate canonical repository is not sufficient by itself; vendored/copied/shared-source objects collapse to their source family and are excluded
family.click_relationship: Typer is a CLI framework built on Click lineage; release 0.27.1 contains a typer/_click subtree carrying Click licensing, so typer/_click/** is excluded rather than credited to Typer
family.fastapi_relationship: Typer and FastAPI share the fastapi GitHub organization and primary maintainer, but are separate non-fork repositories; shared governance does not collapse source families absent shared-source identity
family.pydantic_relationship: typer/_typing.py explicitly states it was copied and reduced from pydantic 1.9.2, so it is excluded from Typer family capacity

obligations: include the copyright notice and MIT permission notice in all copies or substantial portions of the Software

selection_exclusions: typer/_click/**: Click-derived/vendored lineage; do not count as Typer capacity
typer/_typing.py: upstream marks it copied/reduced from pydantic 1.9.2
typer/__init__.py and typer/__main__.py: version/bootstrap metadata, not substantive capacity
all other typer/** files: not authorized by this bounded snapshot

dedup_policy.lineage_exact_blob_scan: scan selected blob identity across complete pinned Click and FastAPI trees
dedup_policy.lineage_near_scan: scan selected object against pinned analogous Click and FastAPI implementation files

admission_scope: typer/utils.py at the exact pinned commit only; no repository-wide or release-wide authority
